voice_122:r_ca4acbac57a2a35e.text: I am Hades!\nYour guide to Hell!

voice_122:r_70b9c4b9f1f37eff.text: Show me your face twisted in pain!

voice_122:r_3559d2fad32c2435.text: Ha ha ha!\nDie with your regrets!

voice_122:r_f7570547e9f80a64.text: Zeus!\nNow that I am here, it's over!

voice_122:r_83ec59afbecdec14.text: Would you betray us as well?!

voice_122:r_e20bfd42ad95a3c9.text: If you forsake duty to fight me...!

voice_122:r_0f58a8822381e57f.text: That vehicle will be your coffin!

voice_122:r_6dbcc507fb61b51d.text: I will wipe out every human!

voice_122:r_77ca87eacd17ad52.text: I'll burn you away without a trace!

voice_122:r_aabfb21c9d069ce7.text: I'll rip you apart, then burn you!

voice_122:r_02479dc8fe989560.text: You can't escape my twin blades!

voice_122:r_48b60d6c48b9b142.text: You must have a death wish...!

voice_122:r_8927e6fb681aa809.text: I commend your nerve in facing me!

voice_122:r_665f01666859013b.text: You'd flee the King of the Dead?

voice_122:r_a571eec59b258d11.text: Have you bid this world farewell?

voice_122:r_ddbe581c5ea9183d.text: Then I shall kill you in return!

voice_122:r_d4430bf362340b32.text: Stand aside! Hades claims the kill!

voice_122:r_6ff1323b355593e0.text: Mycenae's warrior, leave this to me!

voice_122:r_36133ad73a73ef98.text: A warrior of Mycenae, so pathetic!

voice_122:r_920740a0219c5085.text: I let you be,\nand you grow arrogant!

voice_122:r_3633df5b7b8f47fa.text: Gnnn! Did I use too much power...?

voice_122:r_1b9b2aab5cb104da.text: Ha ha ha! Weak! So weak!

voice_122:r_cf41e8828a90cbdb.text: Your attack cannot even reach me!

voice_122:r_ec2ea17765052401.text: I am invincible! Give up all hope!

voice_122:r_f2d4255f1c2f7542.text: Ha ha!\nOne arm can't defeat me!

voice_122:r_5d08ad19e2da125b.text: Zeus! Is that the best you can do?!

voice_122:r_a7246b52782a877e.text: A mere fake!\nYour veneer peels away!

voice_122:r_065443f6ddfcf0d7.text: Wah ha ha! You took the bait!

voice_122:r_47d52a2839c71715.text: That won't work against my flames!

voice_122:r_857c4a52ce8df0fd.text: Hmph! I needn't have come myself!

voice_122:r_8fdf5910927c9591.text: Ha ha ha ha ha ha! Resist me more!

voice_122:r_7d724dbcc4451e10.text: You! Are you that eager to die?!

voice_122:r_93e25418a203cb8f.text: My wrath burns!\nI'll rip you apart!

voice_122:r_24cf161287ef9d5c.text: Gnnn! Will you defy me to the end?!

voice_122:r_5213c17e13b23de0.text: This one...! Power equal to Zeus'?!
